basic_info.description: Little Saigon Village, SF, CA, there's a great opportunity  on offer here. It is the only 2br 1 bath with parking for sale under 400K in San Francisco, and it's a nice unit. This 2 bedroom 1 bathroom unit is in a very good 1990 construction building with a side alley parking garage. Light filled, city views, big rooms, tall ceiling heights are throughout the flat. Well run HOA with a low monthly payment. Easy to see by appointment.
